headline: 95–103°F heat wave — water today, potato window closing.
weather_notes: Run both zones today — 3 days since Aug 2 irrigation with 95°F today and 100–103°F Thu–Fri puts every bed past the heat re-water threshold.
Do all outdoor work before 8 AM through Friday — 95°F Wed, 100°F Thu, 103°F Fri leave no workable afternoon window all week.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds through midday — 46-day transplants risk sunscald and blossom-drop at 95–103°F with first harvests still 3 weeks out.
Harvest ripe blackberries today or Thursday morning — 103°F Friday will cook any ripe Triple Crown fruit still on the canes.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 26 days overdue — today at 95°F and Thursday morning at 100°F are the only outdoor windows before 103°F Friday closes cane work through the weekend.

suggested_tasks.title: Probe potato bags — window closes tomorrow
suggested_tasks.description: Yukon Gold at 78 days hits the end of its 65–80 day harvest window on Aug 7 — probe one bag this morning before 103°F Friday accelerates vine collapse.

suggested_tasks.title: Check w4 onions for soft necks and harvest
suggested_tasks.description: Super Star and Yellow Sweet Spanish at 102 days are deep in their maturity window — squeeze necks and pull soft bulbs before this week's 100°F+ accelerates post-maturity rot.
